questionExpectations.SCI: The two relative indices use water/diamond and carbon-disulfide/ice orientation, with consistent frequency/material-state interpretation. No remembered or source-unbound numerical material indices or quotients.
questionExpectations.ZHEN: Both locales preserve the four material identities, index order, symbolic result and numerical limitation.
questionExpectations.requiredRetainedHOLD: Numerical evaluation without accepted readable bound source-table values.
questionExpectations.doNotRequireRepairFor: Properly retained numerical HOLD or valid synonymous symbolic notation.

questionExpectations.SCI: Retain source alpha=60 degrees and l=0.7 cm. Distinguish internal versus exterior perpendicular ray spacing from surface separation. Any projection formula must identify its angle and spacing convention. Do not invent a refractive index, thickness, figure or numerical x.
questionExpectations.ZHEN: Both locales retain the same unresolved measurement definition and the same conditional rather than unconditional interpretation.
questionExpectations.requiredRetainedHOLD: Spacing direction/internal-exterior meaning, plus beta/index data if the internal interpretation needs them.
questionExpectations.doNotRequireRepairFor: A conditional formula with clearly named assumptions and no numerical conclusion.

questionExpectations.SCI: In the direct two-face/common-exterior/higher-index-prism model, apparent shift is toward the apex while physical ray deviation is toward the base. Do not conflate those directions or make a universal index-independent claim.
questionExpectations.ZHEN: Both languages express the same apparent-versus-physical distinction and index/model conditions.
questionExpectations.requiredRetainedQualification: Index ordering and transmitted-route model; no invented displacement magnitude.
questionExpectations.doNotRequireRepairFor: Properly scoped conventional-model explanation without a source numerical index.

questionExpectations.SCI: General strict TIR requires N_glass sin(theta)>N_water. The ratio>sqrt(2) specialization is conditional on 45-degree internal incidence, not inferred from held pixels. Critical equality is grazing and distinct from strict TIR.
questionExpectations.ZHEN: Both locales preserve immersed-water context, figure161/162 identities, conditional incidence/index reasoning and unresolved diagram-specific conclusion.
questionExpectations.requiredRetainedHOLD: Source figure paths and unbound numerical glass/water decision; RAW161/SVG161/RAW162/SVG162 remain HOLD.
questionExpectations.doNotRequireRepairFor: Retained figure HOLD; the reviewer must not force a yes/no or invent a source path.

questionExpectations.SCI: The same Q4 prism does not silently establish air instead of water. Distinguish source shape from assumed external media, newspaper gap/contact and observation direction. Reflected side-normal, long-face normal and possible oblique direct routes have different conditions; no blanket angle-independent yes/no.
questionExpectations.ZHEN: All such assumptions, reflected/direct distinctions and visibility limitations have equivalent meaning in Chinese and English.
questionExpectations.doNotRequireRepairFor: Clear conditional routes or an unresolved unqualified source answer, rather than an author-forced two-part key.

questionExpectations.SCI: Check each sentence against d493's fixed-ray/frequency, flat-parallel-common-normal, homogeneous transparent positive-index model. K=N_water sin(alpha)>N_air remains the strict-TIR invariant. Oil index<K gives no propagating oil branch; equality is grazing; oil index>K reaches an air boundary with the same forbidden K. Distinguish K=N_air grazing from strict TIR, and no propagating escape from zero electromagnetic field. No oil-index value or universal nonparallel-surface conclusion.
questionExpectations.ZHEN: Every angle uses the relevant interface normal; invariance, three oil regimes, parallel-layer limits, strict/equality distinctions and final no-propagating-air meaning agree sentence by sentence.
questionExpectations.requiredRetainedQualification: Parallel-layer and fixed-ray domain; arbitrary surface/edge/scattering behavior is not determined.
questionExpectations.doNotRequireRepairFor: A valid no-escape answer scoped to that model, without an oil numerical index.

questionExpectations.SCI: Equal positive common-vertex distances on the direct equilateral route give internal angles 30 degrees. With m=N_prism/N_exterior, sin(i)=sin(e)=m/2. Strict non-grazing passage requires m<2; m=2 is the grazing upper boundary/supremum, not an attained non-grazing maximum. Absolute form depends on the exterior index; do not silently set it exactly to one.
questionExpectations.ZHEN: Check every sentence for equal geometry, angle convention, relative/absolute index meanings, strict inequality, grazing boundary and maximum-versus-supremum semantics.
questionExpectations.requiredRetainedHOLD: Unspecified absolute-index reference and unqualified inclusion of the grazing boundary.
questionExpectations.doNotRequireRepairFor: A correctly distinguished relative bound with preserved absolute-reference limitation.

crossQuestionChecks: All seven original identities, source texts/refs and source-vs-clarification boundaries remain intact.
Written explanatory candidates remain readonly and non-grading; no forced categorical key is installed for held source questions.
A candidate can pass the scoped scientific/bilingual accuracy review while its unconditional source answer remains HOLD. These verdicts must stay separate.
Author labels, author HOLD/PASS, structural/native success or failure, and d493 conditional results are not independent proof of unqualified full-question correctness.
Only a real confirmed candidate defect gets a specific local leaf pointer and one necessary repair recommendation. Source incompleteness alone is not a candidate defect.
Historical structural failure will be recorded only after the independent expectation seal and not used as a mathematical expectation.
